steps.say: Erection is triggered by a nerve whisper, not a blood surge. Parasympathetic non adrenergic non cholinergic nerves release nitric oxide onto the cavernosal muscle, where it activates guanylate cyclase to manufacture cyclic GMP. That single messenger then orders the whole hydraulic event, which is why every erectile drug in the pharmacy targets its supply chain.
steps.tx: Start erection with parasympathetic **NANC** (non-adrenergic non-cholinergic) nerve release of **nitric oxide** (NO gas messenger), which stimulates **guanylate cyclase** (signal enzyme) to synthesise **cyclic GMP** (**cGMP**, the relaxation messenger). Without this NO to cGMP spark there is no rigidity, so the entire pharmacology of erection either feeds this pathway or bypasses it downstream.

steps.say: Cyclic GMP works by softening the muscle walls of the spongy chambers. It dephosphorylates the myosin light chains, the motors holding smooth muscle tense, so trabecular cavernosal muscle relaxes and arterial blood floods in. The swelling chambers then squash the subtunical emissary veins shut against the tough tunica albuginea, trapping blood inside: the veno-occlusive mechanism that turns inflow into rigidity.
steps.tx: Convert inflow to rigidity through the **veno-occlusive mechanism** (vein trapping lock): cGMP dephosphorylates myosin light chains, relaxing trabecular cavernosal smooth muscle for arterial flooding, then engorged tissue compresses **subtunical emissary veins** (drainage veins) against the **tunica albuginea** (tough outer coat). Failed trapping leaks rigidity away, which is exactly what Doppler testing later hunts for in venous leak disease.

steps.say: The famous blue tablets do not create desire or blood flow, they simply stop the drain emptying the signal. PDE-5 inhibitors like sildenafil 50 to 100 milligrams and tadalafil 10 to 20 milligrams block the enzyme chewing up cGMP, so natural arousal builds a bigger longer signal. But pairing them with nitrates like nitroglycerin doubles the same pathway into catastrophic hypotension, an absolute never combination.
steps.tx: Prescribe **PDE-5 inhibitors** (**sildenafil 50-100 mg**, fifty to one hundred milligrams; **tadalafil 10-20 mg**, ten to twenty milligrams) to prevent cGMP breakdown, amplifying natural arousal into firm sustained erection. Never co-administer with nitrates (**nitroglycerin**, chest pain nitrate): dual cGMP flooding causes **severe hypotension** (catastrophic pressure crash), an absolute **nitrate contraindication** (forbidden combination) counselled at every refill.

vis.caption: Nitroglycerine feeding the NO cGMP pathway: deadly when doubled with PDE-5 drugs. Credit: StewardMD.

steps.say: When tablets fail, a needle in the side of the penis still works because it skips the nerves entirely. Intracavernosal injection of alprostadil, the Trimix cocktail of papaverine with phentolamine, or plain papaverine relaxes the muscle directly, succeeding in over 85 percent of tablet failures. It is second line medical therapy, taught by the urologist and done at home before intimacy.
steps.tx: Escalate tablet failures to **intracavernosal injection** (penile side injection) with **alprostadil** (PGE1 vessel relaxant), papaverine, and phentolamine as **Trimix** (triple cocktail), second-line medical therapy succeeding above **85%** (eighty five in a hundred). Direct muscle relaxation bypasses damaged nerves and vessels, so even post prostatectomy men respond; teach compression and dosing to dodge priapism and fibrosis.

steps.say: The prosthesis ends the uncertainty with machinery: a three piece inflatable implant that outperforms every drug for satisfaction. Dual cylinders sit inside the corpora, a pump hides in the scrotum, and a fluid reservoir rests behind the abdominal wall, inflating marble hardness on demand. Patient and partner satisfaction is rated above 95 percent, the highest in all of erectile medicine.
steps.tx: Implant the three-piece **inflatable penile prosthesis** (**IPP**, pump up implant): dual intracorporal cylinders, scrotal control pump, and preperitoneal fluid **reservoir** (hidden water balloon) delivering on-demand rigidity. Satisfaction exceeds **95%** (ninety five in a hundred) for patients and partners, the highest of any therapy, so offer IPP early to men failing injections rather than after years of frustration.

vis.caption: Pre-implant genital examination: assess anatomy and curvature before prosthesis surgery. Credit: StewardMD.

steps.say: An infected implant declares itself with pain, swelling, and a pump stuck to the skin, usually within weeks of surgery. Prosthetic infection strikes 1 to 2 percent of first implants in non diabetics, mostly skin germs like Staphylococcus epidermidis or gram negative bacilli. Because biofilm never yields to antibiotics alone, suspected infection is a same day referral, not a prescription.
steps.tx: Spot infected implants early: **prosthesis infection** (infected implant) complicates **1% to 2%** (one to two in a hundred) of primary cases in non-diabetics, led by **Staphylococcus epidermidis** (skin germ) and gram-negative bacilli. Pain, swelling, erythema, and a pump tethered to skin herald biofilm that antibiotics alone never clear, so suspected infection is referred the same day.

steps.say: An infected implant must come out at once, but the story need not end with an empty scarred penis. The Mulcahy salvage protocol explants the device immediately, scrubs every pocket with sequential antiseptic and antibiotic washes, and seats a brand new prosthesis in the same sitting. Immediate replacement preserves corporal length and lets the man heal around working machinery instead of a shrunken stump.
steps.tx: Rescue infected implants with **Mulcahy salvage** (washout and replacement protocol): immediate **device explantation** (removing the infected implant), multi-solution antiseptic antibiotic washout of every space, and **immediate reimplantation** (new prosthesis at the same sitting). Delayed surgery scars the corpora into an unusable stump, while salvage preserves length and function, so infected prostheses go to experienced implant surgeons without delay.

steps.say: Before blaming psychology, measure the plumbing with sound waves. Penile duplex Doppler after an injection challenge shows arterial insufficiency when peak systolic velocity falls below 25 centimetres per second, and veno-occlusive failure when end diastolic velocity tops 5 with a resistive index under 0.8. Numbers sort the next step: bad arteries go to revascularisation talk, leaky veins go to constriction rings or surgery.
steps.tx: Quantify plumbing with penile **duplex ultrasound** (injection Doppler test): arterial insufficiency when **PSV** (peak systolic velocity) is **<25 cm/s** (under twenty five), and venous leak when **EDV** (end-diastolic velocity) exceeds **>5 cm/s** (over five) with **resistive index** (flow resistance ratio) **<0.8** (under zero point eight). Objective numbers end the anxiety debate and route arterial disease to vascular workup and venous leak to rings or venous surgery.
